collection.title: Formes & Signes
collection.subtitle: Lyrical Biomorphic Abstraction
collection.curatorial_statement: Inspired by the poetic surrealism of Joan Miró, Alexander Calder, and mid-century European master lithographers. Characterized by raw sumi ink gestures, deep smoked indigo silhouettes, warm Tuscan ochres, and celestial glyphs on warm archival paper.
collection.paper_spec: 200-250 gsm Museum-Quality Archival Matte Paper (FSC-certified Giclée printing)

products.title: L'Envol Indigo
products.subtitle: Hero Focal Print
products.description: A dynamic ascending avian silhouette in deep smoked midnight indigo, grounded by warm terracotta and Tuscan mustard discs, cut through by an expressive raw black sumi-ink sweep. Printed edge-to-edge on warm archival cotton paper.

products.title: Bleu Lunaire
products.subtitle: Lyrical Companion
products.description: An organic ultramarine cobalt pebble shape accompanied by lyrical calligraphic wire contours, a whimsical crescent moon glyph, and subtle ochre and cadmium dot accents.

products.title: Ocre Cosmique
products.subtitle: Warmth Anchor
products.description: A grounding composition featuring warm earthy Tuscan mustard and terracotta gouache forms, intersected by delicate looping gestures, a graphic eye motif, and a celestial starburst.

products.title: Polyptyque Lithographique
products.subtitle: Master Folio Study
products.description: A continuous 3-panel lithographic folio study celebrating primitive handprints, constellation rhythms, and masterly printmaker marks on textured archival paper.

bundles.title: The Signature Diptych (Set of 2)
bundles.description: The perfect dialogue of blues: pair L'Envol Indigo and Bleu Lunaire side-by-side in natural oak frames.

bundles.title: The Collector's Triptych (Set of 3)
bundles.description: The complete 3-piece gallery wall balance spanning midnight indigo, vibrant cobalt, and warm Tuscan ochre.
